title: Initial general-purpose remote agent release
what: Separate the Pi Durable/pi-ai/Cloudflare Agents SDK core from Slack/GitHub/Webhook adapters, and expose a shared API and Void Web UI. Specifications are in docs/mission.md and CONTEXT.md.

acceptance.text: Build the independent agent server and Void React Pages UI
Keep Slack/GitHub dependencies and mandatory origin labels out of the core
Accept Slack/GitHub mentions and authenticated Webhooks durably
Control conversations, status, stop, and model selection from the Web UI
Use authorized GitHub App and isolated tools, stopping coding work at pull requests
Document automated verification and unverified live-service behavior
